faqTitle: Frequently Asked Questions Vikki Safe Plus

faqs.title: How long can I buy insurance?
faqs.content: You can flexibly choose the Vikki Safe Plus insurance term from 1 month to 12 months, depending on your personal needs and plans.

faqs.title: When does the insurance policy take effect?
faqs.content: The insurance policy takes effect immediately after premium is successful paid.

faqs.title: How long is the waiting time of Vikki Safe Plus insurance?
faqs.content: Vikki Safe Plus does not apply a waiting period. Your insurance benefits are effective immediately after successful payment.

faqs.title: Do I have to pay any additional fees/charges in addition to the premium?
faqs.content: Except premium, you will not need to pay any additional fees or further charges.

children.title: Who can be insured person for this accident insurance?
children.content:
Person insured can be any individual who fully meets all the following conditions:

  • Vietnamese citizen or foreigner residing in Vietnam at the time the insurance contract takes effect.
  • From full 18 years old to 75 years old.

The participant must not fall into the following cases:

  • Suffering from mental illness, neurological illness or leprosy.
  • An injured or permanently disabled person with a disability of 50% or more.

Should you not be in the age range specified above, please contact HD Insurance for further advice.

children.title: Do I need a medical check-up when I enroll in insurance?
children.content: No medical check is required upon inception of this insurance.

children.title: Will the premium be changed during the insurance term?
children.content: No, the premium will not change throughout the coverage period.

children.title: After joining, can I change my insurance benefits?
children.content: You cannot change your insurance benefits during the insurance term. You can only change them at the time of renewal of the insurance policy on the condition that it is accepted by HD Insurance.

children.title: In case the accident occurs before the effective date of the insurance but the medical expenses incurred during the insurance term are covered?
children.content: No, this insurance policy only covers direct medical expenses originating from accidents that occur during the insurance period.

children.title: What documents are included in the dossier of request for insurance payment?
children.content:
For the most detailed and complete information about the necessary documents in the Insurance Claim Dossier, please refer to the “Claim Guide” section in the Vikki app.

Alternatively, you can contact the Claim Settlement Unit stated on the Certificate of Insurance for guidance on collecting the claim dossier on a case-by-case basis.

children.title: How long does it take to settle a claim?
children.content: HD Insurance is responsible for settling insurance claims within 15 days from the date HD Insurance receives the full and valid insurance claim dossier.

children.title: Who is the beneficiary?
children.content:
In case of an insurance event, insurance benefits shall be paid in the following order of priority:

  • Insured.
  • Designated beneficiary.
  • The legal heir of the Insured in case there is no designated beneficiary.

children.title: Can I terminate my insurance policy before it expires?
children.content: If you wish to terminate the insurance policy before the expiration date during the insurance period, you must notify HD Insurance in writing/email 30 days before the intended termination date. HD Insurance will refund 80% of the premium corresponding to the remaining insurance period provided that no claim has been incurred under this insurance policy.

children.title: Who do I contact if I need assistance or have questions related to this policy?
children.content: You can contact HD Insurance's Customer Service Specialist for advice or call HD Insurance's policy management support number stated on the Certificate of Insurance if you have any questions about the policy.

children.title: In case of loss of the Electronic Certificate of Insurance, what should I do?
children.content:
Option 1: You can look up your E-Certificate of Insurance in the email used when registering for insurance.

Option 2: Go to https://e-certificate.hdinsurance.com.vn/, then fill in the relevant information to look up and download your E-Certificate of Insurance.
